content: The Sequence Counter Jump Width between two consecutive SYNC or two consecutive OFS messages of the same Time Domain shall be greater than 0 and smaller than or equal to Fr TS ynGlobalTimeSequenceCounterJumpWidth . Otherwise a Time Slave shall discard the respective SYNC / OFS message. The FrTSynGlobalTimeSequenceCounterJumpWidth value 0 is not allowed.

The Sequence Counter Jump Width between two consecutive SYNC or two consecutive OFS messages of the same Time Domain shall be greater than 0 and smaller than or equal to FrTSynGlobalTimeSequenceCounterJump- Width . Otherwise a Time Slave shall discard the respective SYNC / OFS message. If the FrTSynGlobalTimeSequenceCounterJumpWidth value is set to 0, the Time Slave shall not do Sequence Counter Jump Width checks.
